events.feedSummary: Oren finds a private captain using his preliminary storm estimate as a guaranteed fair-weather certificate.
events.detailBody:
At Tide Observatory, Oren finds a private captain using his preliminary storm estimate as a guaranteed fair-weather certificate. Sami Haddad checks the fort watch notes. Idris Vale finds the boat whose departure relies on the paper. Keon Flint compares the island sky report.

Oren Gale labels the uncertainty publicly and asks for the paper back.
